## Snow Golem (CR 4)

This enormous, lumpy snowman moves with a heavy, but steady gait.  

**XP** 1,200  
N Large construct (cold)  
Init—1; **Senses** darkvision 60 ft., low-light vision; Perception +0  


**Defense**


**AC** 13, touch 8, flat-footed 13 (–1 Dex, +5 natural, –1 size)  
**hp** 80 (5d10+30); snow repair  
**Fort** +1, **Ref** +0, **Will** +1  
**Immune** cold, construct traits, magic  
**Weaknesses** vulnerability to fire  


**Offense**


**Speed** 20 ft.  
**Melee** slam +9 (1d6+7 plus 1d6 cold)  
**Ranged** snowball +3 (1d6+5 plus 1d6 cold)  
**Space** 10 ft.; **Reach** 10 ft.  
**Special Attacks** cold (1d6), snowball effect  


**Statistics**


**Str** 21, **Dex** 9, Con—, Int—, **Wis** 11, **Cha** 1  
**Base Atk** +5; **CMB** +11; **CMD** 20  


**Special Abilities**


**Cold (Ex)** A snow golem’s form is extremely cold, dealing 1d6 cold damage with its attacks. Creatures attacking a snow golem unarmed or with natural weapons take this cold damage each time one of their attacks hits.  

**Immunity to Magic (Ex)** A snow golem is immune to any spell or spell-like ability that allows spell resistance, with the exception of spells and spell-like abilities that have the Fire descriptor, which affect it normally. In addition, certain spells and effects function differently against the creature, as noted below.
